value.rationale: The natural operational restriction forbidding two consecutive zero commands changes both whether an automaton can be reset and its worst-case shortest command length. This first-small-size exhaustive boundary yields 5424 lost ordinarily synchronizing machines, a sharp reset-delay 12 on a sole 24-element state-conjugacy class, and the full constrained latency spectrum. The precise finite extremizer structure is an independently motivated test case for regular-constrained synchronization, not a renaming of an unrestricted bound.
